items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S5439

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to amend the racing, pari-mutuel wagering and breeding law, in
relation to the agriculture and New York state horse breeding
development fund


 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL :
To provide that members on the Agriculture and New York State Horse
Breeding Development Fund, not including the Chairman of the Racing
and Wagering Board and the Commissioner of the Department of
Agriculture and Markets, be required to have experience in the
breeding of standardbred horses.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :
Section 330 of the Racing, Pari-Mutuel Wagering and Breeding Law is
amended to include such chairman and members of the state harness
racing commission must be experienced or have been actively engaged in
the breeding of standardbred horses in New York State.

 JUSTIFICATION :
This bill would provide for a statutory requirement for breeder
representation on the Agriculture and New York State Horse Breeding
Development Fund. To date, there is no such representation.  This bill
seeks to gain the same input from the harness breeders on decisions
that impact their industry that the Thoroughbred Development Fund
enjoys from their statutorily required for thoroughbred breeders on
their Fund Board.

The harness racing and standardbred breeding industry is a leader in
the nation and has grown significantly with the advent of VLT's on
racetracks in New York State. Standardbred breeder representation and
input on the Agriculture and New York State Horse Breeding Development
Fund is critical as the Fund Board of Directors makes significant
decisions regarding the future of the standardbred breeding and racing
industry in New York.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
New bill.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately.

B.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S5439B

TITLE OF BILL:
An act
to amend the racing, pari-mutuel wagering and breeding law, in relation
to the agriculture and New York state horse breeding development fund

PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL:
To provide two additional members
with experience in breeding standard bred horses on the Agriculture
and New York State Horse Breeding Development Fund.

SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS:
Section 330 of the Racing, Pari-Mutuel
Wagering and Breeding Law is amended to provide for two additional
members with experience or have been actively engaged in the breeding
of standardbred horses on the Agriculture and New York State Horse
Breeding Development Fund and shall have no voting privileges. Of the
additional members, one appointed by the chairman of the New York
state racing and wagering board and the other appointed by the
commissioner of agriculture and markets and shall serve terms of no
more than three years.

JUSTIFICATION:
This bill expands the New York State Horse Breeding
Development Fund by adding two members that have experience or have
been actively engaged in the breeding of the standardbred industry.
To date, there is no such representation. This bill seeks to gain the
same input from the harness breeders on decisions that impact their
industry that the Thoroughbred Development Fund enjoys from their
statutorily required for thoroughbred breeders on their Fund Board.

The harness racing and standardbred breeding industry is a leader in
the nation and has grown significantly with the advent of VLT's on
racetracks in New York State. Standardbred breeder representation and
input on the Agriculture and New York State Horse Breeding
Development Fund is critical as the Fund Board of Directors makes
significant decisions regarding the future of the standardbred
breeding and racing industry in New York.

PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:
New bill.

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:
None.

EFFECTIVE DATE:
Immediately.
